load_videos_from_manifest: load frame or encoded videos from CSV manifest files into a Video dataset dictionary
convert_frame_numbers_to_filepaths: convert frame numbers to zero-padded file paths for a video using VideoFrameInfo metadata
parse_hms_timestamp_to_seconds: parse an HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS.fraction timestamp string into total seconds as a float
save_encoded_video_manifest: save a dictionary of EncodedVideoInfo objects to a CSV manifest file for later reuse
save_video_frame_info: save a dictionary of VideoFrameInfo objects to a CSV file for later reuse
